{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2019–20 |team=Syracuse Orange |sport=Basketball |image=Syracuse Orange logo.svg |image_size=100px |conference=Atlantic Coast Conference |division= |short_conf=ACC |record=18–14 |conf_record=10–10 |CoachRank= |APRank= |head_coach=[[Jim Boeheim]] |hc_year=44th |asst_coach1=[[Adrian Autry]] |asst_coach2=[[Gerry McNamara]] |asst_coach3=Allen Griffin |stadium=[[Carrier Dome]] |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2019–20 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2019–20 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team''' represented [[Syracuse University]] during the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Orange were led by 44th-year head coach [[Jim Boeheim]] and played their home games at the [[Carrier Dome]] in [[Syracuse, New York]] as seventh-year members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. The Orange finished the season 18–14, and 10–10 in [[2019–20 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]]. The team was scheduled to play [[2019–20 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|Louisville]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2020 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] before the tournament was cancelled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web |title=Statement from ACC on Men's Basketball Tournament |url=https://theacc.com/news/2020/3/12/statement-from-acc-on-mens-basketball-tournament.aspx |website=theacc.com |publisher=Atlantic Coast Conference |accessdate=12 March 2020}} The [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] and [[2020 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] were also cancelled due to the pandemic.{{Cite web|url=https://www.ncaa.org/about/resources/media-center/news/ncaa-cancels-remaining-winter-and-spring-championships|title=NCAA cancels remaining winter and spring championships|last=|first=|date=|website=|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200312202043/http://www.ncaa.org/about/resources/media-center/news/ncaa-cancels-remaining-winter-and-spring-championships |archive-date=2020-03-12 |access-date=}} ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Orange]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 20–14, 10–8 in ACC play to finish in a tie for sixth place. They defeated [[2018–19 Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball team|Pittsburgh]] in the second round of the [[2019 ACC men's basketball tournament|2019 ACC tournament]] before losing in the quarterfinals to eventual champions [[2018–19 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where, as a No. 8 seed, they lost to [[2018–19 Baylor Bears men's basketball team|Baylor]] in the first round. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
